Glance 2026.08.11.2 adds optional application sources and a complete portable distribution.

## Highlights

- Preview the focused file directly from Everything and browse results in gallery mode with synchronized Everything selection.
- View installed components and sources together on the Add-ons settings page.
- Choose components and sources independently during installation, with every add-on selected by default for new installations.
- Use the portable archive with every supported component and source already included.
